component: Scoped JavaScript iteration and result-state convention

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In the Account Hub sync step, for-of awaits each provider create call in order. A result guard retains the first truthy returned directory; continue keeps that provider from being called twice. The helper receives directory?.UID after the loop. This accepted local form replaces index-based first-result handling and leaves directory initially undefined. It does not ban explicit null initialization, define every empty-result policy, or mean initial remote fetching has completed. No provider, navigation or test ran.
title: Address-book creation uses an ordered for-of loop and a result guard
